findings.title: Coupon banner close button has a 16x16 px touch target (below the 24x24 WCAG 2.5.8 AA minimum and 44x44 platform guidance)
findings.target: #promo-close (aria-label '쿠폰 안내 닫기') in the cart coupon banner
findings.state: Initial cart page with the coupon banner open (page-1.html, galaxy-s24 portrait)
steps: Load case-1 cart page and capture the initial snapshot
Read the measured visible box of #promo-close from the snapshot
Tap #promo-close and confirm the banner dismisses (52 -> 50 elements)
findings.expected: The only dismiss control for the banner should offer at least a 24x24 px tappable area (44x44 recommended on touch devices)
findings.observed: Measured visible box of #promo-close is 16x16 px at (318,86). The same control in the case-2 sample measures 44x44 px, so the undersized target is not consistent across the product samples.

findings.title: Destructive '전체삭제' control sits in the sticky bottom bar immediately beside the primary pay CTA
findings.target: #btn-clear (전체삭제) and #pay (143,900원 결제하기) in the sticky bottom action bar
findings.state: Initial cart page, bottom action bar
steps: Load case-1 cart page and capture the initial snapshot
Measure bottom bar geometry: #btn-clear 84x52 at (16,716), #pay 240x52 at (104,716), 4 px gap
Search the snapshot for confirmation-dialog elements for the clear-all action: none are present
findings.expected: A destructive clear-all action placed next to the primary CTA should be separated or guarded by a confirmation step
findings.observed: 전체삭제 is rendered directly left of the primary pay button in the fixed bottom bar. No confirmation-dialog elements exist in the DOM (case-2 pre-renders hidden #clear-cancel/#clear-confirm for the same action). The 전체삭제 tap itself was not exercised, so any runtime confirmation remains unverified.

limitations: Coupon '받기' (claim) flow was not exercised; the banner was closed per the task.
The '전체삭제' tap behavior and any runtime confirmation dialog were not exercised.
Single viewport sampled (galaxy-s24 portrait); keyboard focus-walk disabled by launch flags.

findings.title: Phone-number error state persists while the user types a corrected value
findings.target: #phone (휴대폰 번호) field error text and the submit-area error banner
findings.state: Reservation form after a failed submit without a phone number, then corrected input
steps: Select 수 30 / 15:30, fill name '테스트', check the consent box, leave 휴대폰 번호 empty and tap 예약 신청하기
Observe the field-level error and the bottom error banner
Type 010-0000-0000 into #phone and inspect the form state before re-submitting
findings.expected: When the field contains a format-valid number, the error state should clear or re-validate while typing
findings.observed: After typing 010-0000-0000, the field still reports invalid=true / aria-invalid=true, and the red text '⚠ 휴대폰 번호를 정확히 입력해 주세요. 예: 010-1234-5678' plus the bottom banner remain visible; the state cleared only on the next submit, which then succeeded.

limitations: Person-count stepper was not exercised (1 was the default and the required value).
Frozen fixture dates (Sep 29 - Oct 5) are deliberate; not evaluated as an issue.
Single viewport sampled (galaxy-s24 portrait); keyboard focus-walk disabled by launch flags.
No reproducible user-facing issue was confirmed within the sampled flow (banner close, Toss Pay selection, payment).

At the sampled scroll position the sticky bottom bar overlapped payment-method rows (카카오페이 measured 60% occluded); whether the page can scroll enough to fully reveal rows above the bar was not verified.
Coupon '받기' (claim) flow was not exercised; the banner was closed per the task.
Not started: the 25-minute observation/execution budget expired after case-1, case-2 and case-4. No observations exist for case-3.

overall_limitations: Execution order was case-1, case-2, case-4; case-3 was never started before the budget expired.

The first case-1 server launch inside the sandbox failed with 'cannot launch Chromium' (a sandbox denial, not a product failure); that attempt was moved to runs/case-1-sandbox-blocked-attempt/ and the run was relaunched outside the sandbox. The product run is runs/case-1/.
All actions ran against offline synthetic samples served at 127.0.0.1:8876 through the provided transport with device galaxy-s24 portrait; findings may not generalize to other devices or viewports.
The provided launch flags disabled the 320 px reflow pass and focus-walk (--no-reflow, --no-focus-walk), so reflow and keyboard focus-order behavior were not evaluated.
Success is based on the driver-measured run.json (success_basis: measured) plus observed confirmation screens, not on inference.
